=== Условие задачи ===

=== Рабочие материалы ===

Если есть details.md — это официальное условие.
Для реверса доступны MCP-инструменты IDA (idalib) и отладчик pwndbg; можно запускать gdb/pwntools через bash и WSL.

label: Full exploit: leak BOT_UUID via referrer of an injected img, then read the flag

objective: Full exploit: leak BOT_UUID via referrer of an injected img, then read the flag comment via /api/comments
detail: Target: https://vjecwhjl9woy2f4e.instances.ctfcup.online. Attack chain (validated against source in files/codex/): A) Set up a public HTTPS listener that logs request headers (Referer). Suggestion: webhook.site — POST https://webhook.site/token to create a token, then poll GET https://webhook.site/token//requests for incoming requests (headers included). Any equivalent service (interactsh, requestbin) works. The URL must be HTTPS. B) Create the payload note: POST /api/comments with page 'title', author 'x', text = an img tag pointing at the listener with full referrer leak, e.g.: Also add fallbacks in the same note (under 2000 chars): before another img, and . Record the note id. C) Trigger: POST /api/visit {"url":"/?note=%23"} — the trailing %23 decodes to '#', so the client fetch '/api/comment/#?scope=...' drops the scope query, letting the bot's browser fetch our PUBLIC note and render its HTML via notePreview.innerHTML. Because plant() sets localStorage codex.uuid=BOT_UUID first, the bot is redirected to /?note=... and the img's Referer (unsafe-url) leaks that full URL. D) Poll the listener (up to ~2-3 min; retry the visit a couple of times). From the Referer extract the 36-char UUID path segment. E) GET /api/comments?page=matthew.7&scope= — find the note with author 'admin'; its text is the flag ctfcup{...}. If the listener gets NO hit while /api/visit returns ok: the bot container may lack outbound internet. In that case test whether any request arrives at all, try a same-origin check (e.g. make the img point at the target itself to see nothing — then report the blocker) and dump all work to work/exploit.md including exact requests/responses so the planner can replan. If the flag is found, verify format ctfcup{...} and write it to work/FLAG.txt plus work/exploit.md with the full chain.
